Title: Glaucoma: The Eye Disease That Can Be Normal-Pressure

Description:
Glaucoma damages the optic nerve as fluid pressure builds inside the eye, but many people with it actually test in the normal pressure range. Here's how it differs from macular degeneration, who's at higher risk, which habits spike eye pressure, and the signs that mean an eye emergency.

Glaucoma can damage your vision even when your eye pressure tests normal 👁️

It's called normal-tension glaucoma - a pressure check alone can miss it, so a visual field exam matters too.

Head-down yoga poses can spike eye pressure fast, while aerobic exercise tends to lower it.
